children: Yellow River Holdings (00318) said the publication of its FY2026 annual results has been delayed because additional time is needed to complete the audit process, according to ETNet.

The company said that, following recent discussions with its auditor, it now expects to publish the annual results before mid-September, provided the remaining audit procedures are completed. Its FY2026 annual report will also be delayed accordingly.
Yellow River Holdings said its shares have been suspended from trading on the Stock Exchange since 9:00 AM on August 3 and will remain halted until the FY2026 annual results are released.

title: Yellow River Holdings Expects FY2026 Results Before Mid-September
